notes.title: Morels: Homestead - Now Playable on Valve Index
notes.notes:
We are excited to announce that Morels: Homestead is now playable on the Valve Index!

We were finally able to figure out the issues with the Grip button on the Valve Index and the game should now be playable.

Thank you for all your patience and support!

-The Abrams Studios Team

notes.title: Homestead Item Update!
notes.notes:
[h2]HOMESTEAD ITEM UPDATE[/h2]

We are excited to announce a new update featuring over 200 new Homestead Items to purchase for your homestead in the Farmer's Market. You will now see a "New" category at each vendor. These will have the new items added for each vendor. This way you will not have to scroll through and try to find any new items.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42945762/5b36394d1eebef961f4211b65d3b2fd3c391272c.png[/img]


[h2]HOMESTEAD METAL DETECTOR ITEMS[/h2]

You can now search and find items using your metal detector in your homestead maps.


[h2]BUG FIXES[/h2]

We have fixed the Old Car in the Texas Ranch quest. This can now be completed.

We want to thank everyone who has played the game and has given us feedback. It means a lot to us. You can reach out to us at any time at contact@morelshomestead.com or for support issues support@morelshomestead.com.

-The Abrams Studios Team

notes.title: Morels: Homestead is releasing on May 16th, 2023.
notes.notes:
Release day is less than a week away. Morels: Homestead will release on May 16th for the Oculus Rift platform. Let us know if you have any questions about the game. You can also reach us at contact@morelshomestead.com for general questions and support@morelshomestead.com for support questions.

Thank you to everyone for your patience and support. It means a lot to us.

-The Abrams Studios Team
